maria: FYI I'm seeing a confusing case with the embeddings + rerank flow in the JS SDK. batching helper seems to return arrays of different lengths than the rerank endpoint expects.
kevin: ugh. do you have a minimal repro?
maria: yeah pasted below. calling `sdk.embeddings.batchEncode(['a','b','c'])` returns shape [3, 1536], but when I feed the vectors into `sdk.rerank.score(query, candidatesVectors)` the SDK does `if (vectors.length !== candidates.length) throw` — but the vectors array it checks is flattened in our helper.
alex: can you paste the helper code? might be a shape/flatten bug.
maria: here's the helper snippet:
```js
// batch helper
function batchEncode(texts) {
  return sdk.embeddings.batchEncode(texts).then(res => res.flat()); // <- suspect
}
```
maria: the flat() is wrong when we expect array of vectors. I guess I originally flattened to store in a cache.
sam: hmm, but we also saw reports where dims mismatch (1536 vs 1024). are there multiple models returned?
maria: good catch — on hosted we default to model 'open-embed-large' (1536) but the rerank sample app in examples uses 'open-embed-small' (1024). mismatch when users copy-paste.
kevin: two things: (1) DX should make the helper return consistent nested arrays, no implicit flatten. (2) sample app should validate dims and throw a clear error message (or auto-quantize?)
alex: agreed. we should also add a runtime sanity check in `sdk.rerank.score` that verifies vector dimensionality and reports both expected and actual dims in the error. current `!==` only shows counts.
maria: example of improved error: `InvalidEmbeddingShape: expected dims=1536 but got 1024 for candidate 4`
sam: also observed auth retry behaviour: when embeddings request 429s and then succeeds, our helper cached an incomplete response (partial vectors) and later rerank consumed it. probably need to make the batch helper retry + atomic cache writes.
kevin: yes, atomic replace of cache key only after full set present. add idempotent request keys.
/alex: devex-bot: created issue #3421: "SDK: embedding batch helper should not flatten; add dim validation + robust retry/caching" :white_check_mark:
maria: thanks. I'll open a PR to fix helper in examples and add a unit test that simulates mixed-model dims.
kevin: can we also add a small CLI check script users can run on onboarding to validate their pipeline (model alignment between embeddings and rerank)? put in `examples/validate-embeddings.js`
sam: love that. short-term mitigation: update docs with an explicit note: "Ensure embeddings model dims match rerank/ann index dims" and add sample error troubleshooting.
maria: will do. anything else?
alex: add changelog entry and mark as bugfix for the next patch release.
maria: awesome. I'll link both PRs to the created issue.
